title: Database migration - app in maintenance
text:
Daniel Ortiz migrates the free-time data to the new format used by matching service v0.3.

- The Pairly app shows a "We'll be right back" screen for up to 2 hours
- Full backup taken before starting
- Rollback plan: restore the backup (about 15 minutes)

Wop: send the notice to the Westbrook beta testers on Friday. Tomas shares it in the campus group chat.
No testing during this window.
